title: Day 13: Santa Monica
body: Made it back to Southern California. Santa Monica pier and relaxing. Very little left in the tank after 112 degree hiking in the Grand Canyon. Game day tomorrow!

title: Day 12: Grand Canyon Sprint
body: Van. Plane. Helicopter. Boat. I can’t believe we got Mom out on the glass walkway!

title: Day 11: Pool Day and Cirque du Soleil
body: 104 degrees. Watched soccer in the cabana, lazy river’d and saw Ka. Grand Canyon tomorrow.

title: Day 10: Shin Lim is a Witch
body: He would have been burned at the stake 300 years ago. Lincoln described it as “mind melting” and he’s spot on. 10/10, A++, Amazing

title: Day 10: Viva Las Vegas
body: Made it to Vegas. Soup dumplings in the desert!

title: Day 9: Seattle is Amazing
body: After our best nights sleep in a week,  Julia and I are planning out our retirement in Seattle.

title: Day 8: Dos a Cero!
body: Nailed it. 2-0. Seattle is such an awesome sports city. Also, the Socceroos are a fun bunch!

title: Day 8: I Believe!
body: Seattle dominates LA. This is going to be amazing. We will win 2-0.

title: Day 7: Seattle!
body: The rental car was driven into the ground before its passengers! Doing that drive was ambitious, but we made it and boy did we see A LOT.

title: Day 7: Crater Lake… Whoa
body: Highlight of the trip! Crater Lake is like another planet. Time to drive 7.5 hours to Seattle to watch the USA beat Australia and finally stop driving!

title: Interlude: Made it to Oregon… Almost Done Driving
body: We have been pushing HARD pretty much since we landed.  We have seen a lot, but are ready to get rid of this minivan :) Because of the chaos getting into the first match, we decided to adjust plans and get to Seattle a day early. We briefly considered skipping Crater Lake, but decided instead to drive 9 hours on Thursday. Kids are beasts.

title: Day 6: Walking Among Giants
body: Redwoods are massive. Ladybird Johnson Grove was just the easy hike we needed.

title: Day 6: Agate Beach
body: Searching for moonstones and jade. London got a haul.

title: Day 5: Glass Beach
body: Finally got to dip our toes in the Pacific Ocean.

title: Day 5: Skunk Train Railbikes
body: We made it over the Golden Gate Bridge into redwoods country. Railbikin’ along pudding creek.

title: Day 4: Dropping L&L off at Kid Jail
body: After years of empty threats, we’re finally following through on kid jail. Lincoln’s got 30 to life… London is going to run the show.

title: Day 3: We’re Professional Tourists
body: Kids have become numb to being in the car. Julia is thrilled we’re at the same hotel for 2 consecutive nights. Jamey hasn’t stopped talking about Ghirardelli ice cream…

title: Day 3: Bye Yosemite
body: Waking up to the sound of rushing water is the way to do it

title: Day 2: Yooooooosemite
body: Wow wow wow

title: Day 2: Roadtrip!
body: Car is decorated and we’re on our way to Yosemite!

title: Day 1: USA crushes Paraguay 4-1!
body: Couldn’t have asked for a better start to the tournament. Probably should have scored 6 or 7. The atmosphere was absolutely incredible, Seattle has a tough act to follow! We leave for Yosemite at 7am :)

title: Day 1: Game 1: Lets Go!!!!
body: Unbelievable energy! Kids are such troopers powering through. I predict 3-0 good guys :)

title: Day 1: Putting that Flight Behind Us
body: Dragged ourselves out of bed, threw on the jerseys and met up with an old friend (Danny Mac!) who served as an awesome uber driver, photographer and Broad Museum tour guide! Almost game time…

title: Day 0: This was NOT the Plan
body: 4.5 hour delay leaving Newark. Boarded, taxied, and next in line to takeoff when they brought us back the gate and deplaned us. Canceled flights left and right to the west coast but somehow we made it. The kids improvised by sleeping on their tray tables for this “reverse redeye”.

title: 4 Years in the Making!
body: Rooting on Team USA during the last World Cup

title: We're Going to the World Cup!
body: It's official — tickets, flights, and a very excited family ready to experience the World Cup on American soil. Three USA group stage matches, West Coast National Parks, Vegas Shows, the Grand Canyon, and a lot of miles in between. Follow along here for updates, photos, and the live map of where we are.
